race.description: Christmas @ Mvrc 20 Dec Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: SIDEACT (4) stalked the leader then tried hard but had to settle for the runner-up prize when resuming last start over this distance at Coffs Harbour. Lightly raced three-year-old who should kick on following that hit-out. Drawn to enjoy the perfect run and looks a huge chance to go one better. AIRBURST (5) is back after a four-month spell for a third campaign. Encountered wet tracks for the entirety of the last prep and performed well. Recent Port Macquarie trial winner who looks ready to hit the ground running. PLUME (9) made a late charge but just missed the placings in a busy finish recently over this trip at Port Macquarie. Racing well but finding that breakthrough victory elusive. Good each-way option again. CHERRY JUBILEE (7) returns from a 23-week break. Usually needs a run to settle in but her three placings from four at this distance gives her some credibility. Debutante FLOWERHEAD (11) was half a length behind AIRBURST in a recent trial. Looks to have ability.
